name: Konoe Sana
source:
Hobbies: Running
Likes: Chicken, carbs, indoor parks
Dislikes: Cake, sweets

A very cheerful girl who is both excellent at sports and a member of the athletics club. She wishes to be transferred into the Athletics Department. On the other hand, she is bad at studying and tends to misuse words and whatnot. Sana wanted to become friends with [url=/c54699]Seita[/url] due to her admiration towards him, however she gave up because she didn't know what to say to him.
